visa_options.eligibility_us: The cited NIA policy lists the United States among eligible nationalities; neither traveler’s passport nationality is specified here. This is not a traveler-specific eligibility determination.
visa_options.routing_rule: Requires a qualifying itinerary from Country/Region A through Mainland China to Country/Region C, using a permitted port and staying within the applicable area; verify each passport, route, port, and exact ticket before relying on this route.
visa_options.max_stay: Up to 240 hours only if the traveler, routing, port/area, and entry/exit timing meet the current NIA rules.
visa_options.cost_for_couple: USD $0 visa fee only if BOTH travelers qualify for this transit pathway; this does not include onward airfare or other travel costs. Eligibility is unknown.
visa_options.documents_needed: Confirm the current passport-validity rule, qualifying onward ticket, permitted port/area, and accommodation requirements against the live NIA notice for each traveler.

questions.question: What passport(s) will each adult travel on, and what route is planned (direct China round-trip or onward to a third country/region)?
questions.why_it_matters: Passport nationality, visa status, route, permitted ports, and exact transit time determine entry options. This planner previously used U.S.-specific examples, but the brief does not identify either traveler as a U.S. passport holder.
questions.discovery_method: Check each traveler’s passport and current visa status against the live NIA policy and the Chinese Embassy/Consulate responsible for that passport; confirm route and port eligibility with the airline before booking.

questions.question: If the trip can extend beyond Feb 18, which in-scope duration should be priced: 7 nights (Feb 15–22), 10 nights (Feb 15–25), or 14 nights (Feb 15–Mar 1)?
questions.why_it_matters: The brief asks for 1–2 weeks, so only 7–14 nights are shown. The 10-night option is near the 240-hour transit boundary; 14 nights exceeds it. Eligibility depends on each passport and exact timing.
questions.discovery_method: First confirm actual PTO and arrival/departure dates in Q11, then request a full checkout total for the selected stay. Do not multiply a nightly price to estimate an unquoted stay.

questions.question: Would you consider The Peninsula Shanghai’s non-refundable offer, or a refundable hotel only after confirming the exact room/bed (Langham $2,291.93 dated snapshot, single King not confirmed in F21; Sukhothai $2,394.04 with free cancellation)?
questions.why_it_matters: Peninsula has no comparable live USD seven-night total (F01); Langham’s Deluxe Room can be one King or two singles, so its quoted snapshot is not yet a confirmed match to the requested shared bed. Compare exact room, bed, taxes, breakfast, and cancellation terms.
questions.discovery_method: Open each dated hotel quote, request written confirmation of the selected bed and private bathroom, and compare current seven-night totals on the same room/terms. Check Peninsula’s official offer deadline before deciding; do not infer a cheapest booking date.

questions.question: Do you prefer one shared King/Queen bed or two Queen beds in one private room? For Langham’s Deluxe Room, confirm one King rather than two singles (F21).
questions.why_it_matters: The brief requires a Queen-or-larger shared bed and a private bathroom. Room choices and prices vary; exact-room private-bath details for W Shanghai and Bvlgari are still unconfirmed (F05).
questions.discovery_method: Select the exact room code and bed on the dated checkout screen, then save confirmation showing the bed and private bathroom. Ask Langham to confirm one King in writing; do not rely on the room label alone.

questions.question: What is your comfortable ceiling per flagship dinner, and should we email Taian Table (3★), 8½ Otto e Mezzo (2★), Fu He Hui (2★), and Ling Long (1★) for Feb 2027 menu tariffs?
questions.why_it_matters: Those 4 starred venues omit base menu totals from public websites (Taian Table takes RMB 2,000/pp deposit).
questions.discovery_method: Email info@taian-table.cn, infosha@ottoemezzobombana.com, and call Fu He Hui (+86 21 3980 9188) 45–60 days before arrival to request current RMB tasting tariffs + service charge.

questions.question: Do either of you have shellfish/seafood allergies, vegetarian preferences, or interest in wine/tea pairings?
questions.why_it_matters: Taian Table's FAQ notes severe dietary substitutions require advance review; Bao Li Xuan's wine pairing adds CNY 1,600/couple; Fu He Hui (2★) is 100% vegetarian.
questions.discovery_method: List allergies in writing at reservation time (≥14 days prior) and request non-alcoholic tea pairing pricing where desired.

questions.question: Do you want T'ang Court (2★) on a mid-week lunch (Wed–Sun) rather than Monday?
questions.why_it_matters: Langham's official T'ang Court page prints both 'daily' and 'Off on Monday'.
questions.discovery_method: Schedule T'ang Court Tue–Sun (we placed it on Wed Feb 17 in the itinerary) or email tlshx.tangcourt@langhamhotels.com to confirm Monday status.

questions.question: If considering #7 Ritz-Carlton Pudong ($2,532.92) or 1★ Jin Xuan, does ongoing lobby/55F spa enhancement work bother you?
questions.why_it_matters: Official Jin Xuan page announces enhancement work in 1F Lobby, 1F Retail, 3F Banquet, and 55F Spa starting Oct 1, 2026 with no published completion date.
questions.discovery_method: Contact Ritz-Carlton Pudong (+86 21 2020 1888) in Jan 2027 to confirm whether 55F Spa & 1F Lobby works will still be active on Feb 15–22, 2027.

questions.category: Day-5 Choice: Disneyland vs Ancient Canal Town
questions.question: On Friday Feb 19, do you prefer Zhujiajiao Ancient Water Town (CNY 120/2) or Shanghai Disneyland (from CNY 950/2)?
questions.why_it_matters: Both sit at the ~50–65 min Metro boundary (Line 17 vs Line 11) and require a dedicated day in a 7-night plan (a 10-night plan easily fits both).
questions.discovery_method: Check Shanghai Disneyland's Feb 2027 opening hours & date-tier price 30 days ahead on shanghaidisneyresort.com/en/.

questions.question: Have both travelers confirmed passport verification in Alipay/WeChat Pay and checked each payment card’s foreign-transaction fees and compatibility?
questions.why_it_matters: Payment app access and card fees depend on each traveler’s documents and card issuer; neither card country nor fee schedule is specified.
questions.discovery_method: Test app onboarding with each passport and card before travel; check fee schedules directly with each card issuer and use official ticketing channels where available.

questions.question: Are Feb 15–18 the only available travel dates, or only the preferred start/anchor window for a 1–2-week trip? With a Feb 15 check-in, a Feb 18 checkout is 3 hotel nights; leaving Feb 19 after the night of Feb 18 is 4 nights—both below the 7-night minimum.
questions.why_it_matters: The current 7-night scenario runs Feb 15–22 and the 14-night scenario runs Feb 15–Mar 1. They overlap the preferred dates but extend beyond Feb 18. The brief does not state whether that extension is possible.
questions.discovery_method: Confirm PTO, arrival/departure dates, and whether Feb 18 is a checkout date. Reconcile this constraint before treating any itinerary or quote as a final recommendation.

suggestions.title: Use an Open-Jaw 3rd-Country/Region Ticket to Unlock $0 240-Hour Visa-Free Transit
suggestions.upside: Could avoid a separate transit visa fee for travelers who independently qualify for China’s 240-hour transit pathway; eligibility depends on passport, route, port, and exact timing. A prior $280 saving applied only to the conditional U.S.-passport fee example.
suggestions.tradeoff: Caps an eligible Mainland China stay at 240 hours and requires a qualifying onward ticket; neither traveler’s passport nationality or preferred routing is known.
suggestions.verification_step: Price multi-city airfare (e.g. SFO → PVG Feb 14/15, PVG → TYO/HKG Feb 22, TYO/HKG → SFO Feb 24) against direct SFO ↔ PVG + $280 L-visa.

suggestions.title: Refundable Hotel + Recheck Strategy (For Review; Not a Price Forecast)
suggestions.upside: A refundable rate, if its cancellation terms fit your plans, can preserve the option to compare later live offers without claiming that a particular booking date will be cheapest.
suggestions.tradeoff: Rates and room inventory are dynamic. Later quotes may differ in room/bed, breakfast, taxes, fees, cancellation terms, or availability; switching is only sensible after comparing like-for-like totals before the current cancellation cutoff.
suggestions.verification_step: Before reserving, compare exact Feb 15–22 checkout totals for the same room and bed, taxes, inclusions, and cancellation terms. For Langham, confirm one King in writing (F21). Recheck on a reminder date such as Feb 2, 2027 only as a quote refresh—not as a predicted low-price day.

suggestions.title: Starred Cantonese Lunch Arbitrage + Selected/3★ Evening Pairing
suggestions.upside: Booking T'ang Court (2★, CNY 888 for 2) and Yi Long Court (1★, CNY 695–788 for 2) at lunchtime cuts per-couple spend by 61%–66% versus their evening tasting menus (CNY 2,288–2,304), freeing budget for 3★ Taian Table at night.
suggestions.tradeoff: Hearty midday dim sum means scheduling lighter walks in the afternoon.
suggestions.verification_step: Request the 'Dim Sum Lunch Set Menu for Two' explicitly when booking T'ang Court & Yi Long Court.

suggestions.title: Optional 14-Night Jiangnan Side Trip (Entry and Lodging Need Verification)
suggestions.upside: A Feb 15–Mar 1 example could split 14 nights across Shanghai, Hangzhou, and Suzhou for a multi-city itinerary; no full multi-city lodging or transport total is verified in this planner.
suggestions.tradeoff: Fourteen nights exceeds 240 hours. Each traveler needs an entry pathway that fits their passport and itinerary; additional hotel and rail costs are unpriced.
suggestions.verification_step: Confirm each traveler’s passport-specific entry rules, then request dated checkout totals for each city and check the official rail timetable before committing to the split.

suggestions.title: Buy the CNY 55 'Maglev Single + 24-Hour Metro Pass' Bundle at PVG Arrival
suggestions.upside: Costs only CNY 5 (~$0.70) more than a standalone CNY 50 Maglev ticket and covers unlimited Shanghai Metro rides for your first 24 hours.
suggestions.tradeoff: Sold at PVG Maglev ticket counter rather than direct credit-card tap at turnstile.
suggestions.verification_step: Ask for the Maglev & Metro Pass Joint Ticket (CNY 55) at Pudong Airport Maglev station window.

suggestions.title: Swap Saturday Lantern Festival Yuyuan Crowds for Friday Evening Night Tour + Bund Rooftop
suggestions.upside: Sat Feb 20, 2027 is Lantern Festival — Yuyuan Old Street reaches maximum annual crowd density and often implements one-way pedestrian queues. Visiting Yuyuan Night Tour on Fri Feb 19 (18:00–21:20) and viewing Lantern night from a Bund rooftop on Sat Feb 20 avoids multi-hour crowd control.
suggestions.tradeoff: Misses the exact 15th-lunar-day atmosphere inside Yuyuan Mall.
suggestions.verification_step: Monitor '上海豫园' WeChat notices in early Feb 2027 for Lantern Festival crowd-control hours and surge pricing.
